text: {"features":[{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree / Master's degree / Doctoral degree","name":"Educational attainment","description":"Captures the highest level of formal technical education the letter presents as preparation for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree, equivalent practical experience, or no advanced study highlighted."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."}]},{"evidence":"3 years / 5 years / 7 years","name":"Relevant experience duration","description":"Captures how much directly relevant professional software engineering time the letter claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Below the role's minimum or unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Meets the bar, typically around 2 to 3 years of relevant experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Solid mid-level tenure, typically around 4 to 5 years."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Extensive tenure, typically 6 or more years in relevant software work."}]},{"evidence":"launching 2 / 4 / 6 production services","name":"Production service breadth","description":"Captures how much concrete exposure the letter shows to testing, maintaining, and launching real production services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Little or no concrete production-service exposure is stated."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one or two production services or otherwise modest breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows experience across several production services, roughly three to four."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows broad exposure across many production services, typically five or more."}]},{"evidence":"Go as my daily driver","name":"Go centrality","description":"Captures how central Go appears to the applicant's recent professional work rather than being a peripheral language.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is missing, unclear, or only incidental."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned as a language used, but not as a main vehicle for work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go is clearly presented as the primary or day-to-day language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Go is central to multiple production systems or explicitly tied to backend or security-infrastructure ownership."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse","name":"Python depth","description":"Captures how much substantive Python work the letter describes, especially in production, tooling, or automation contexts.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No Python experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Python is mentioned only generally or as light scripting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Python is presented as regular production tooling or service work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Python is shown as deep, production-grade work central to automation, internal services, or extensible systems."}]},{"evidence":"shipping LLM-based features / evaluation scaffolding","name":"AI production maturity","description":"Captures whether the letter shows real applied AI experience and how responsibly that experience is framed.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"AI or LLM exposure is mentioned without clear production detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI work plus reliability thinking such as evaluation, safeguards, or nuanced discussion of failure modes."}]},{"evidence":"designed agentic pipelines end to end","name":"Agentic systems ownership","description":"Captures how directly the letter shows design or implementation responsibility for agent-based systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic systems experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents in passing or as limited exposure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or designing agentic tooling with clear Go and Python components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end architecture ownership with bounded actions, guardrails, auditing, or deliberate interface design."}]},{"evidence":"automated vulnerability report handling","name":"Vulnerability automation depth","description":"Captures how concretely the letter demonstrates automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related security-response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No vulnerability automation experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation vaguely without a clear workflow example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear example of automating vulnerability intake, classification, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows robust workflow ownership, such as deduplication, prioritization, ownership assignment, or a largely self-serve pipeline."}]},{"evidence":"performed security assessments","name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Captures the extent of direct hands-on security review work described in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security assessment work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions assessments at a high level without showing method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or remediation validation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practitioner nuance, such as attacker-minded review, design-assumption probing, or structured assessment methodology."}]},{"evidence":"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation","name":"Algorithmic sophistication","description":"Captures whether the letter demonstrates substantive use of data structures and algorithms to improve systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No algorithms or data-structure capability is shown."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength but gives little concrete evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a specific example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong example showing substantial technical leverage, such as graph, index, deduplication, or streaming redesign work."}]},{"evidence":"OSCP certification / CompTIA Security+","name":"Security credential strength","description":"Captures the strength of formal external security credentials the letter cites.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security credential is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a baseline credential such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a strong hands-on credential such as OSCP or an equivalent applied certification."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag competitions / near-top finishes","name":"Offensive practice intensity","description":"Captures whether the letter shows active offensive-security practice outside ordinary job duties and how serious it appears to be.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No offensive-security practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional or casual capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular or serious capture-the-flag practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong performance evidence, such as near-top finishes in major events."}]},{"evidence":"submit patches upstream / maintain an open-source project","name":"Open-source contribution depth","description":"Captures how much the letter shows the applicant contributing to or maintaining software beyond their employer's codebase.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Only a personal project is mentioned, with no external user or contributor signal."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional upstream patches or small contributions to shared tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows maintenance or leadership of an open-source project, library, or framework with users or contributors."}]},{"evidence":"distributed job scheduler / bookmarking tool","name":"Personal project ambition","description":"Captures the technical ambition and systems complexity of self-directed projects described outside core job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small utility or lightweight side project."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a solid nontrivial project with meaningful engineering substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Mentions an ambitious systems project tackling distributed, consistency, recovery, or other hard infrastructure concerns."}]},{"evidence":"too many signals, too few experts","name":"Security automation framing","description":"Captures whether the letter shows a clear thesis about why security automation matters for this team and problem space.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in security work without a clear automation thesis."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation as useful but does not explain the core security-scaling problem."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly explains automation as a way to reduce manual workload or scale expert judgment."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a crisp, role-specific view of security automation as organizational capacity building for vulnerability handling, triage, or variant analysis."}]},{"evidence":"improvements are inherited by every team downstream","name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"Captures how strongly the letter expresses motivation to work on foundational infrastructure with compounding downstream impact.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No explicit foundational or platform-impact motivation appears."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at liking scale or infrastructure, but not as a central theme."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly values work whose improvements propagate across teams or products."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes compounded downstream leverage a central reason for applying."}]},{"evidence":"make the secure path the easy path","name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Captures whether the letter frames security work as helping product engineers succeed through usable defaults and low-friction tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not address the developer experience of security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire to help other engineers."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes reducing friction, proactive support, or secure defaults over policing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Richly frames security tooling as successful only when busy engineers will actually adopt it because it removes toil and embeds best practices into workflow."}]},{"evidence":"read code the way an attacker would","name":"Security identity maturity","description":"Captures how much the letter presents the applicant as already thinking and operating like a security engineer rather than merely adjacent to the field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a general software engineer with little security grounding."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Reads as security-adjacent and interested in learning more."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows established security practice through multiple direct activities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Conveys a mature security-engineering identity, with a clear attacker, builder, or rigor-first philosophy."}]},{"evidence":"design ownership / architected / led","name":"Ownership seniority","description":"Captures the level of independent responsibility and initiative the letter claims for systems or security work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly aspirational language or support-role contribution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some hands-on contribution but limited ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of tools, systems, or reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated architecture, design, or lead responsibility with independent judgment."}]},{"evidence":"hours of expert attention it returned","name":"Impact articulation","description":"Captures whether the letter explains the outcomes of the applicant's work rather than only listing activities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists tasks with no visible outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at benefit but remains mostly activity-based."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States clear outcomes such as reduced manual work, faster systems, or fewer bugs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong leverage language, tying work to capacity, attention saved, or meaningful organizational effect."}]},{"evidence":"aligns directly with the stated requirements","name":"Role alignment clarity","description":"Captures how directly the letter maps the applicant's background to this specific posting's requirements and responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The fit is vague and the reader must infer most of the relevance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Some relevant matches are stated, but the mapping to the posting is incomplete or indirect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly connects several experiences to the role's stated needs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes the match easy to verify, systematically covering most of the key qualifications or responsibilities."}]},{"evidence":"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities...","name":"Narrative distinctiveness","description":"Captures how memorable and individual the letter's voice feels beyond a generic requirement-matching template.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Highly formulaic prose with little individual voice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Competent but generic prose with only limited individuality."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes a memorable framing device, belief, or personal thesis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Sustains a distinctive, authentic voice throughout while still serving the application's purpose."}]},{"evidence":"misspellings such as engnieer and seucre","name":"Surface polish","description":"Captures the copyediting quality of the letter at the sentence and word level.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent distracting errors materially hurt professionalism or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors are present, though the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Only minor occasional mistakes appear; overall the letter reads as professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clean, polished copy with no obvious language or typographical errors."}]}]}
